# NeuroLab by Vicoworks

> A free interactive 3D laboratory for learning how large language models work, available in Indonesian and English.

Canonical origin: https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com. Publisher: [Vicoworks](https://vicoworks.com). All simulations run client-side. Five tools and six missions explore tokenization, embeddings, attention, residuals, sampling, and KV caching. Reference scale is GPT-3 175B; inspectable numbers use a deterministic two-block toy model, not GPT-3 weights. Full educational text is also available as HTML and Markdown.

## Start here
- [Indonesian interactive LLM lab](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/id/): Belajar LLM secara interaktif.
- [English interactive LLM lab](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/en/): Learn LLMs interactively.
- [Full bilingual text](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/llms-full.txt): Complete educational guide and topic explanations.

## English lessons
- [What Is LLM Tokenization? Learn with Interactive Visualizations](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/en/learn/tokenization/): Markdown at https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/content/en/tokenizer.md
- [Token Embeddings and Positions in LLMs](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/en/learn/embeddings-position/): Markdown at https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/content/en/embedding.md
- [Query, Key, Value: How LLM Attention Works](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/en/learn/query-key-value/): Markdown at https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/content/en/qkv.md
- [Causal Attention and Masking in Transformers](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/en/learn/causal-attention/): Markdown at https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/content/en/attention.md
- [Transformer Blocks: Residuals, LayerNorm, MLP, and GELU](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/en/learn/transformer-block/): Markdown at https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/content/en/transformer.md
- [LLM Sampling: Temperature, Top-k, and Top-p](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/en/learn/sampling-temperature/): Markdown at https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/content/en/sampling.md
- [What Is a KV Cache? Understanding LLM Prefill and Decoding](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/en/learn/kv-cache/): Markdown at https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/content/en/cache.md
- [Vector Analogies and Static Embeddings](https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/en/learn/vector-analogies/): Markdown at https://llm-explained.vicoworks.com/content/en/analogy.md
